description: Detach a resource from an app: remove the environment variables it set and, if the app is running, ask for a restart so its next process starts without them. The state is detached when that is done, and detaching while Valet still owes the restart or the removal, which it keeps trying; the answer gives the reason. The running process keeps the variables until it is replaced. A variable whose value is not the one the resource set stays on the app, and the answer names it. The resource itself and its data are unchanged, and other apps that hold it keep it. Detaching a resource that is not attached changes nothing. Requires connecting a Valet account.

name.description: The app's name, as list_services shows it: the app to detach the resource from.

org_name.description: The Valet organization the app belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

resource.description: The resource's name in the organization.

name: detach_resource

env_vars.description: Names of the environment variables the detach removed from the app. Never their values.

kept_env_vars.description: Names of variables a detach left on the app because their values are not the ones the resource set. Absent when it kept none.

name.description: Name of the app the resource was detached from.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

plan.description: Plan the resource runs on. Absent for a resource created from environment variables.

provider.description: Provider the resource was provisioned from. Absent for a resource created from environment variables.

reason.description: Why a failed resource failed, as the provider said, or why the attachment is attaching, detaching, or conflicted. Absent when there is nothing to explain.

resource.description: Name of the resource detached, which stays in the organization. Pass it to destroy_resource to delete it.

resource_id.description: ID of the resource. Absent when the call stopped before it found or created one.

state.description: detached when the detach finished, or detaching when Valet accepted it and keeps removing the variables in the background (reason says why). A resource that was not attached to the app also reads detached.

title: Detach a resource from an app
